sourceClaims.claim: Golos Text Regular/Medium/SemiBold is authoritative across 2,193 source text nodes.
Fira Sans is a compatibility profile and does not redefine Figma truth or shared component geometry.
Reusable roles retain exact observed size, weight, line-height, and letter-spacing combinations.
The fallback stack is engineering policy because the library does not distribute Golos font files.

evidence.source-integrity: pass: typography extraction classifies 2,193 raw text nodes into 36 merged signatures while retaining family, size, weight, line-height, and letter-spacing
evidence.structural-contract: pass: source tests verify Golos as the default profile, Fira as compatibility-only, exact reusable roles, fallback stacks, and inherited profile switching
evidence.runtime-browser: pass: browser tests load Latin and Cyrillic Fira faces and verify Golos/Fira switching on roots and subtrees without changing fixed component heights
evidence.accessibility: not-applicable: metric fidelity, inheritance, font loading, and unclipped test content do not prove general text accessibility or component readability policy
evidence.focused-visual: pass: the Fira compatibility snapshot and focused Pagination typography assertions cover representative role geometry
evidence.consumer-integration: pass: field, Pagination, status, table, file-row, document-row, and Data Workspace fixtures exercise inherited typography profiles
evidence.responsive-content-stress: pass: browser tests verify long Cyrillic/Latin stress content remains unclipped, intentional ellipsis remains active, and the table row stays 50px under Fira

limitations: Consumers remain responsible for licensed Golos font delivery.
